# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

- A ready-made local harness that execs `my_skill/scripts/*.py` with `env_*` bound to tau2's AirlineTools on db.json (and a "replay all gold actions through the wrappers" check) would make VERIFY-THE-FIX/blast-radius checks standard; I had to build one in /tmp.

## iter 2 — cross-session tool-call leakage in the blackbox proxy
- In 10__cand_0001__t0 the trace contains task 23's calls (get_user_details mohamed_silva_9265 before the user gave an id, cancel_reservation K1NW8N, book_reservation for Mohamed), executed in task 10's env. The DB then mismatches and the trial scores 0. The Skillberry proxy seems to route tool calls to the wrong session when rollouts run concurrently. This adds noise to every flaky-task measurement; consider isolating sessions or flagging contaminated trials.

## iter 3
- Parallel tool calls in one assistant turn run in a nondeterministic order through the proxy (23: three book_reservation calls → reservation ids shuffled across trials). If that is not intended, serialize them in listed order. Otherwise, document it for optimizers.
- Ship a standard "replay all gold actions of tasks.json through the candidate's wrappers" check in the framework, covering train/test as well as val. It is the most reliable SAFE test for guards, and every iteration rebuilt it by hand.
- The trajectory summary gives argument-level misses but not WHY (e.g. order vs value). A per-trial "first write call that diverges from gold" line would speed diagnosis.
